scripts.build: npm run build -w @email2api/shared && npm run build -w @email2api/web && npm run build -w @email2api/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @email2api/server" "npm run dev -w @email2api/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @email2api/server && npm run test -w @email2api/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @email2api/shared && npm run typecheck -w @email2api/server && npm run typecheck -w @email2api/web
